svg.aria-label: Isoclines of the undamped mass-spring system x double dot + x = 0: every isocline x1 + alpha x2 = 0 is a straight line through the origin, and the short marks along it show the slope alpha of the trajectory crossing it; joining the marks gives circles
svg.title: Isoclines of the undamped mass-spring system x double dot + x = 0: every isocline x1 + alpha x2 = 0 is a straight line through the origin, and the short marks along it show the slope alpha of the trajectory crossing it; joining the marks gives circles

g.text: ẋ₁ = x₂, ẋ₂ = −x₁: slope dx₂/dx₁ = −x₁/x₂ = α
